bd-01M162FEGPSY50MFHTYH3C3RHF COMPLETE: 26cdfe1 on m1/resolution, on top of the ratio-of-sums commit 1a11501. Fidelity is now mass-weighted over the anchor distribution with per-facet denominators.

TWO DEFECTS, AND THEY WERE ONE DEFECT. Fidelity admitted a unit only when sourceMass > externalMass - a cliff at 0.5, so a unit at 0.51 contributed its verdict at FULL weight and one at 0.49 contributed nothing - and then scored only that unit's MAP anchor, so a unit split 0.51/0.49 across two anchors was recorded as though the first were certain. Both are the same move: collapse a distribution to a point, then treat the point as certain. Now every anchored state contributes in proportion to its mass.

Per facet, N_f is correct-verdict mass and A_f is SPECIFIED-verdict mass. Unspecified means the recall did not commit to the facet, so it leaves the denominator - counting it would penalise a participant for what they did not say.

MUTATION F1 - restore the cliff, MAP-only, and a COUNT denominator - kills the new test: expected 1.7380529424173567, got 2.0. Only TWO of four units cleared the old cliff, which is worth stating plainly: the previous figure was a mean over two units standing in for a recall of four.

AND MY FIRST VERSION OF THAT TEST DID NOT CATCH IT. I asserted conditioningMass != unitCount and conditioningMass <= sourceMass. Both pass under the mutation, because the surviving-unit count was 2.0 and the source mass 2.63 - an inequality that happens to hold. The test that works RECOMPUTES THE DENOMINATOR INDEPENDENTLY: the mass of every anchored state whose assessment specified at least one facet, built from a different expression over the same inputs. Sixth time tonight that an inequality looked like a discrimination and was not; I have stopped trusting bounds as discriminating assertions.

ONE BRANCH IS UNPROVEN AND I HAVE WRITTEN THAT INTO THE TEST RATHER THAN LEFT IT IMPLIED. Every anchored assessment in AnnaFixture specifies ALL FOUR facets, so the Unspecified path is unreachable from this corpus: F2 - count Unspecified into the denominator - SURVIVES. The per-facet rule is therefore asserted by bounds only. Proving it needs a fixture unit whose proposition omits a facet, which is a fixture change rather than a signature change, and I would rather flag it than quietly ship a comment claiming a guard I did not demonstrate. Happy to build that unit if you want the bead reopened for it.

EVIDENCE at 26cdfe1, clean pin, gate last from the committed tree: alignJVM 166/166, alignJS 166/166, lawsJVM 81/81, interviewJVM 76/76, embedBench 50/50, fixturesJVM 108/108, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmt both green.

Stack on m1/resolution is now 1a11501 then 26cdfe1, parent eda2d37 - the six earlier commits landed in your 0b1ceca merge.
